spans.s:
m. (-कः)
An astrologer.
E.
ज्योतिस् a star, affix टक्; also the vowel being unchanged optionally, ज्योतिषिक.

mfn. (-त्स्नः-त्स्नी-त्स्नं)
Light, especially with moonlight, &c.
E.
ज्योत्स्ना^1 moonlight, अण् affix: see ज्यौत्स्नी^2 and ज्यौत्स्निका^3.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313. note: cf. WIL1819.
[2] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313. note: cf. WIL1819.
[3] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313. note: cf. WIL1819.

f. (-का)
A moonlight.
E.
ज्योत्स्नी and कन्.

f. (-त्स्नी)
A moonlight night, or a night on which the moon is full.
2 A kind of cucumber: see ज्यौत्स्ना.
E.
ज्योत्ली as above, and अण् pleonastic aff.
